trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Greet the user and state the purpose of the outbound call.
steps.text: Hello, இது உங்க property booking lead LD-2009 பத்தி பேசுறதுக்கு call பண்ணிருக்கோம். நான் account holder கிட்ட பேசுறேனா?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask for the reason behind the call.
steps.text: Yes, நான் தான் பேசுறேன். இது எதுக்கு call பண்ணிருக்கீங்க?

steps.purpose: Request verification before discussing account details.
steps.text: உங்க account details discuss பண்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி, நான் verify பண்ணனும். உங்க registered pincode confirm பண்ண முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor.
Verify the customer's identity.
Return verification outcome.
State the business context of the call and prepare to look up details.
steps.text: Thank you. உங்க property-க்கான next instalment due ஆகியிருக்கு, அதான் remind பண்ண call பண்ணேன். நான் exact details check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details to discuss the pending instalment.
Return booking details.
Share the current booking status and pending payment context.
steps.text: உங்களுக்கு unit D-1102-க்கு provisional allotment இருக்கு. நீங்க இதுவரைக்கும் 300000 pay பண்ணிருக்கீங்க, last payment பண்ணி 45 days ஆச்சு.

steps.purpose: Express confusion over domain terminology and ask for plain explanation.
steps.text: 'Provisional allotment' னா என்ன? எனக்கு புரியல. கொஞ்சம் simple ஆ சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Explain the domain term in simple words.
steps.text: அப்படின்னா unit D-1102 உங்களுக்கு தற்காலிகமா reserve ஆகியிருக்கு. Next payment பண்ணாதான் அது confirm ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Repeat the explanation to confirm understanding, state inability to pay, and ask for a loan arrangement.
steps.text: Oh, D-1102 reserve ஆகிருக்கு, 300000 கட்டிருக்கேன். ஆனா இப்போ என் கிட்ட காசு இல்ல. நீங்க loan arrange பண்ணி தருவீங்களா?

steps.purpose: Decline the out-of-scope loan request.
steps.text: இல்ல sir, நாங்க home loans arrange பண்றது இல்ல. அது எங்க process-க்கு வெளியில இருக்கு. நீங்க direct ஆ bank-ல தான் loan கேட்கணும்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the limitation and ask if a refund is possible upon cancellation.
steps.text: அச்சா, loan நீங்க பண்ண மாட்டீங்க. அப்போ நான் cancel பண்ணா, என் பழம் திருப்பி கிடைக்குமா?

steps.purpose: Check the refund eligibility for the booking.
Return the refund eligibility and amounts.
Share the exact deduction and refundable amount based on the tool result.
steps.text: நான் refund eligibility check பண்ணிட்டேன். Yes, நீங்க eligible. நீங்க pay பண்ண 300000-ல, refundable amount 255000. Deduction 45000 ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Repeat the figures to confirm and ask about the timeline.
steps.text: 255000 திருப்பி வரும், 45000 deduction. சரி. இது எப்போ கிடைக்கும்?

steps.purpose: State the processing time exactly as returned by the tool.
Confirm the timeline and ask to proceed with cancellation.
steps.text: 14 days ஆகுமா? சரி, cancel பண்ணிடுங்க. என்னால இப்போ pay பண்ண முடியாது.

steps.purpose: Initiate the refund for the cancelled booking.
Return the refund initiation status and ID.
Provide the refund ID and status to the customer.
steps.text: நான் refund initiate பண்ணிட்டேன். உங்க refund ID REF-7721, amount 255000. Status இப்போ initiated-ல இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Repeat the refund ID to confirm and check if anything else is needed.
steps.text: Refund ID REF-7721, amount 255000. நான் இதை note பண்ணிக்கிட்டேன். வேற எதாவது பண்ணனுமா?

steps.purpose: Confirm completion and close the conversation.
steps.text: இல்ல sir, அவ்வளவுதான். 14 days-க்குள்ள amount process ஆகிடும்.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.
